title: Check-in code
description: Show this code to the kiosk camera to check in.
drawError: We couldn't display the QR code. Please try replacing it or ask the front desk for help.
help: Turn up your screen brightness if the kiosk doesn't read the code.
inactive: There is no active check-in code. Create one to check in with the kiosk camera.
confirmBody: The current code stops working straight away, including any printed or saved copy. Use this if the code was shared or a device was lost.
error: We couldn't load the check-in code. Please try again.
unavailable: Check-in codes aren't available right now. Please ask the front desk.
conflict: The code changed on another device. The latest code is shown; try again if you still want to replace it.
replaceError: We couldn't replace the check-in code. Please try again.
createError: We couldn't create a check-in code. Please try again.
createRereading: A code may have been created, so this page waits until the code has been read again. That needs a connection.
conflictReading: The code changed on another device. The latest code shows once it has been read; then try again if you still want to replace it.
rereading: This code may have been replaced, so it's hidden until it has been read again. That needs a connection.
waiting: Replace code turns back on once the current code has been read again. That needs a connection.
